Why did it take Apple, the biggest, richest tech company on earth, seven years to make a foldable phone? This is why. Just take a look at the internals of iPhone Duo compared to the Galaxy Z Fold 8. Yes, Samsung has made eight different versions of this phone and the inside is still a mess. Now why does this even matter? It’s not like we ever see the inside of our phones to begin with. Well, it’s just a small example of two very different corporate philosophies.
title: Why It Took Apple 7 Years To Make A Foldable iPhone
